<!-- Generated by `chainmail docs`. Do not edit: change the command's help and run `go tool stave docs:commands`. -->

Drop the cached headers and bodies of every account, of the account
--account names, or of one of its folders, and backfill them again from the
mail server. Searches use the server for what is being rebuilt until the
backfill is done. Without --account, accounts whose cache is disabled are
skipped. Running it again is safe.

## Usage

```text
chainmail cache rebuild [--account NAME [--folder FOLDER]] [flags]
```

## Examples

```sh
# rebuild every account whose cache is enabled
chainmail cache rebuild
chainmail cache rebuild --account work --folder INBOX
```

## Flags

```text
      --account string   only this account (default: every account)
      --folder string    only this folder of --account
```

## Global flags

```text
      --output string   output format: json or table (default $CHAINMAIL_OUTPUT, then cli.toml, then table on a terminal, json otherwise)
      --socket string   daemon socket (default $CHAINMAIL_SOCKET, then cli.toml, then /run/chainmail/chainmail.sock)
```
